description: Ministry of Sports - Order made to direct the Director General of the Department of Sports to covene and conduct the election of the Judo Association to elect its new office bearers
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Dayasiri Jayasekara, Minister of Sports) and outlines his detailed responsibilities and powers under the Sports Act, including directing the Director General of the Department of Sports to conduct elections for the Judo Association. It contains both the government person ("who") and detailed government responsibilities/portfolios ("what"), making it a Hybrid Gazette.
